args.command: echo '===SERVICES==='; for s in zen-ops-worker zen-ops-updater.timer zen-ops-results zen-sentinel zen-glances zen-meshcentral zen-openchatx tailscaled ssh; do printf '%s active=' "$s"; systemctl is-active "$s" 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s enabled=' "$s"; systemctl is-enabled "$s" 2>/dev/null || true; done; echo '===PORTS==='; ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':(22|8443|18991|61208|18001|18080|18789|8876|8877|18878) ' || true; echo '===FILES==='; for p in /opt/zen/zen-ops-runtime /var/lib/zen-ops /opt/zen/tools/openchatx-linux-sandbox /var/lib/zen-openchatx /var/lib/zen-ops/work/openchatx-linux-probe /usr/local/bin/zen-ma-dashboard /usr/local/bin/zen-sentinel.py /usr/local/bin/midimonster /usr/local/bin/ltcgen; do if [ -e "$p" ]; then echo PRESENT "$p"; else echo MISSING "$p"; fi; done; echo '===REPO_HEADS==='; git -C /opt/zen/zen-ops-runtime rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; git -C /opt/zen/ZEN-MA2-Agent rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; echo '===UPTIME==='; uptime
